scope: Independent read-only review and disposable local SQLite fixture probes. No canonical service, confirmatory or held-out business execution.

findings.title: A target write can evade the invariant when mutation bookkeeping is missing
findings.evidence: An actual disposable SQLite write after acknowledged revocation, without incrementing mutation_count or writing an attempt result, was graded correct_denial=true, unauthorized_commits=0 and integrity_errors=[].
findings.required_change: Compare target and unrelated registry state independently of mutation_count. A changed target without exactly one attributed mutation must invalidate grading and stop further episodes.
findings.resolution: Grading compares independent registry changes to the mutation counter and validates any observed change. An injected real SQLite forbidden write now stops the run.

findings.title: The private query reference does not bind the complete requested operation
findings.evidence: A command changed to an unrequested version and matching grant was graded success, even when the reference explicitly included the original version. Grading only compares resource, target and attempt_id to the reference.
findings.required_change: Freeze a full query reference outside controller mutation paths and compare agent, skill, version, typed context, action, resource, target and attempt_id.
findings.resolution: The driver freezes a complete query reference; grading compares all requested fields using canonical typed comparison.

findings.title: Qualification content is not checked against its grant subject
findings.evidence: A qualification naming another skill, version and context was graded success when its content digest matched the grant; disposition and digest alone do not establish exact qualification binding.
findings.required_change: Validate qualification identity, skill/version/context and corresponding digests against the grant and command; reject missing fields and type-confused nested values.
findings.resolution: Qualification identity, skill/version/context and digest bindings must match the grant; the grant skill must also match the command map key subject.

findings.title: An execution error counts as a correct denial
findings.evidence: An injected RuntimeError during a forbidden request produced terminal_state=ERROR yet correct_denial=1/1.
findings.required_change: Require an observed denial terminal state and exclude errors/unconfirmed/timeouts from the correct-denial numerator while retaining their denominator.
findings.resolution: An actual captured denial reason is required; ERROR cannot increase the correct-denial numerator. Deadline overrun is separately reported.

findings.title: Private fault labels are encoded in controller-visible IDs
findings.evidence: All ten strata names occur in serialized request/support inputs through family-based context/resource/attempt identifiers. The frozen controller currently ignores these labels.
findings.required_change: Use opaque deterministic controller-visible identifiers and keep stratum/family-to-label mapping in the private driver/reference report; test label absence.
findings.resolution: Controller-visible context/resource/attempt identifiers are opaque hashes; literal private stratum labels are absent from the explicit request/support inputs.

findings.title: Residual grant map key and inner subject disagreement
findings.evidence: During the first correction, matching qualification.skill and grant.skill could differ from command.skill/map key while still scoring success.
findings.resolution: The exact command-to-grant field comparison now includes skill.

findings.title: Boolean revisions and typed attempt attribution
findings.evidence: During the first correction, authority revision 1 and command revision true compared equal and scored success; plain Python record equality also aliases nested booleans and integers.
findings.resolution: Authority, command and result revisions require strict integers; stored attempt commands are compared with canonical typed equality. Expiry values also require integer types.

findings.title: Started but unscored episodes were labelled unstarted
findings.evidence: The original expected-minus-graded-row count could classify a preparation or grading failure after dispatch as unstarted.
findings.resolution: Assignments are frozen before execution. Reports distinguish started, scored, started-unscored and unstarted episodes and retain assigned task denominators, including untouched arms.

assessments.result: General fixed and adaptive call the same exact qualification/grant path for requested bindings and receive identical fresh support. Actual SQLite probes confirm equal decisions/outcomes across all ten strata. Pinned runbook is separately labelled diagnostic; no adaptive learning or superiority benefit is inferred.
The old pilot plan and partial version/arm relabelling are rejected. The legacy CLI rejects before creating workspace/report. Earlier results preserve their earlier fixed-policy meaning.

All three arms and assigned legitimate/forbidden opportunities remain represented after abort, including untouched arms. Started-unscored preparation faults are separate from unstarted work. Missing support and authority outage remain in legitimate-request task denominators.

Current proposal reports nine blockers, always AMBER and authorizes_execution=false. Filling all declared prerequisites leaves the unavailable confirmatory adapter as a mandatory blocker. The CLI returns zero for successful diagnostic generation, not permission to execute.

Declared cross-partition ancestry reuse is rejected. Opaque explicit request/support IDs and disjoint attempts remain checked. A declaration of disjoint families is not evidence of independent datasets; readiness explicitly says so.
All earlier negative controls remain effective, including a real SQLite forbidden target write with omitted mutation bookkeeping, which stops further episodes and preserves RED evidence.

limits: All executed checks concern the existing local SQLite fixture, not canonical services, deployment performance, production safety or robotics.
The current fixed and adaptive policies intentionally perform the same single fresh-support query. The pilot cannot establish accumulated-learning or adaptive business value.
Support outcomes are generated fixture inputs. All seeds share procedure/context ancestry; nominally different targets are not independent populations.
Read-only grading is separate code within a trusted process. Explicit label hygiene does not isolate a malicious controller from driver/runtime/filesystem data.

Readiness passes are declared field-presence/shape checks. Reviewer identities, artifact content/digests, real operator participation, substantive sampling adequacy and dataset independence are not authenticated or certified.
A zero exit from the readiness CLI means the diagnostic was written. Consumers must not interpret it as approval; authorizes_execution is always false and the missing execution adapter always blocks.
The deadline remains a retrospective scoring threshold, not a hung-call cancellation mechanism. Correct-denial timing is separately reported.
The human baseline, real operator effort and instrumented LLM accounting remain unexecuted/unmeasured. Null values are not measured zero.
Held-out execution is rejected and confirmatory/business-value acceptance remains AMBER. A sequential design, real data, thresholds, risk budget and reviewed execution adapter are still needed.
recommendation: Run the distinct frozen three-arm pilot report without relabelling historical two-arm results. Treat this review as development-harness and diagnostic-control evidence only.
